name: dash-shell
summary: POSIX shell for the server image, cross-built from pinned dash v0.5.13 against the independent Darwin runtime.

license.notes: sources.lock.json records 'BSD-3-Clause and generated signal-name tooling GPL-2.0-or-later notices; see COPYING and source notices'. The GPL-2.0-or-later component is build-time signal-name generation tooling.

isolation: Cross-configured against the source-built runtime; the prepared source must match upstream tracked files and the locked revision. Target programs are never executed on the build host.

rebuild.note: Pins are validated by scripts/build/packages.py. A clean-environment rebuild with artifact comparison against a recorded build_shell.py provenance receipt is remaining work.
